target_share:
SELECT 
    player_id,
    player_display_name AS player_name,
    team,
    season,
    ROUND(AVG(target_share), 3) AS avg_target_share
FROM weekly_stats
WHERE position = 'WR' AND target_share IS NOT NULL AND season = 2026
GROUP BY player_id, player_display_name, team, season
ORDER BY team, avg_target_share DESC;
carry_share:
SELECT 
    r.team,
    r.gsis_id AS player_id,
    r.full_name AS player_name,
    SUM(w.carries) AS total_carries,
    SUM(w.rushing_yards) AS total_rushing_yards,
    SUM(w.rushing_tds) AS total_rushing_tds
FROM weekly_stats w
JOIN rosters r ON w.player_id = r.gsis_id
WHERE r.position = 'RB' AND w.season = 2026
GROUP BY r.team, r.gsis_id, r.full_name
ORDER BY r.team, total_carries DESC;
